description.html: The forest spirit is a decorative terrarium stump that combines a mystical look with the practical role of a hide. Shaped to resemble an old forest stump with a spirit's face, this decoration brings character and a story to your terrarium. The hollow interior provides a hide for reptiles, which is key to reducing stress - an animal with access to a hide will be calmer, healthier and show more natural behavior. It is made from material that is safe for use in terrariums. Suitable for all types of terrariums - from humid tropical to dry desert setups. It is easy to clean by wiping with a damp cloth. It can be combined with live or artificial plants for an even more natural look.
Order by phone or WhatsApp. We ship by courier across Serbia. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order in person.
